attributes.name: Fury of the Drowned Desert
attributes.powers:
The Fury of the Drowned Desert may not be evaded and is immune to the Acid, Mental, and Poison traits. All damage dealt by the Fury of the Drowned Desert is Acid damage.

Before you act, succeed at a Strength 9 check or you may play no more than 1 card on the check to defeat.
